incidents.name: BDEX BvaultsStrategy unprotected withdrawal
incidents.notes: The BvaultsStrategy exposed its swap/withdraw entry point to any caller, so the attacker moved the strategy's WBNB out through the BDEX pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: BvaultsStrategy 0xB2B1DC3204ee8899d6575F419e72B53E370F6B20 created 2021-05-11T06:52:16Z by 0x4c4871e1c48bc7c1e86d9cf3d41846e9a2c24c36, unrelated to attack sender 0x5bfaa396c6fb7278024c6d7230b17d97ce8ab62d; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 18.9245 WBNB left the strategy; 18.9245 WBNB x $314.52 at incidentTimestamp 1667152122 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $5,952.
